text:
Maya P: Heads-up — we're targeting ap-south1 for the next cluster bring-up. Need GPU quota reservations + cost signoff before we kick off provisioning tomorrow morning.

Raj K: What SKUs/counts are we requesting? full capacity or phased?

Maya P: Initial ask: 40 x A100-80GB, 20 x H100-80GB. Phase 1 reserve 12 A100 + 6 H100 for smoke + perf tests, then scale to full commit after validation.

Sylvie: Tagging finance? we need cost approval and committed spend window. Also remind procurement to request "reservation hold" not just quota increase.

Raj K: Agreed on phased. Can someone paste the quota request template?

Maya P: Putting the template below (copy for ticket):
```
project: redwood-infra-ap-south1
region: asia-south1
sku: A100-80GB
quantity: 12
start_date: 2026-04-01
end_date: 2026-06-30
justification: cluster bring-up + perf validation for Redwood Dedicated ap-south1, initial phase.
contact: maya@redwood.ai; raj@redwood.ai
```
And duplicate for H100 lines. Link to internal guide: https://redwood.internal/proc/gpu-quota-request

InfraBot: Ticket created: QREQ-2026-431. Status: pending procurement review. ETA response: ~48h.

Linda (Eng-Infra): Quick validation checklist for phase 1 once reservation is in place:
- confirm quotas show up in cloud console for project
- provision 1 validation node pool (k8s) with taints for GPU nodes
- run CI smoke: `kubectl run gpu-smoke --image=nvidia/cuda:11.8-base --limits="nvidia.com/gpu=1"`
- run perf: `python perf/load_test.py --gpus 6 --seq_len 2048`
- validate KV cache warmup and throughput metrics in console
- create rollback plan if latencies > 120ms p95

Kevin - SRE: Networking notes — ensure the following before full allocation:
- private VPC peering established with control plane subnet
- MTU 9000 between nodes (iperf3 test)
- confirm NVLink topology on nodes: `nvidia-smi topo -m`
- make sure PCIe bifurcation settings match image (see onboarding doc)

Raj K: Cost roughs: Phase1 ~ $45k/month (on-demand equivalent), full commit discounts will be required for long window. Finance: please confirm whether we can convert to a 3-month commitment after smoke.

Sylvie: FYI, region has lower local capacity during festival week (anticipated 2026-04-10 -> 2026-04-17). Might need slightly earlier reservation or flexible fallback region (ap-southeast2).

Maya P: I'll update the ticket with phase windows and festival note. Raj to own handoff and test signoff. Linda to run validation once infra team gives thumbs up.

Raj K: Ack. I'll ping procurement and finance right after confirmation.

InfraBot: Reminder scheduled: QREQ-2026-431 follow-up in 36h.

Maya P: Thanks all — will post the finalized reservation numbers + cost approval here when confirmed. :thumbsup:
